scope: Recover the valid v1 workbench when the v2 key contains JSON that is not actually a version-2 record; require each storage key to match its declared schema version.

gap_and_fix.verified_gap: readWorkspacePreferences treated any parsed object in the version-2 storage key as a valid current record. Empty objects, version 1 objects under the v2 key, and unsupported future versions therefore hid an available valid v1 record and silently returned current defaults.
gap_and_fix.red_reproduction: A new Node regression with v2='{}' and valid v1 {version:1,layout:'inspector',theme:'aurora'} failed before the fix: actual layout='canvas', expected layout='inspector'.
gap_and_fix.fix: Accept a stored record only when it is a JSON object whose explicit version matches its storage key (v2 key requires version 2; v1 key requires version 1). Continue to the legacy record on malformed, non-object, missing-version, wrong-version, or unsupported-version data. Keep recovery read-only; explicit edits still write normalized version-2 preferences. The module cache-buster is 20261105-workspace-schema-recovery.
data_and_product_contracts: A valid version-2 record continues to take priority over stale v1 data.
The old v1 record remains unchanged at startup and is only a recovery source.
The first explicit appearance edit writes the normalized v2 record.
A record in either key must match that key's own schema version.
No Page Model, Save, Publish, or public-renderer write is made.
